summary: Rocket Lab Corporation filed an 8-K reporting entry into an equity distribution agreement to sell up to $3 billion of common stock, through agents or via forward sale agreements with multiple banks. The at-the-market offering allows periodic sales; forward transactions involve borrowing and selling shares to hedge. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation is stated. The filing is an ordinary capital-raising arrangement, not a special situation. What to watch: pace of share issuance and dilution impact.
